journal.text: First session 2026-01-02, $50k cash, no holdings. Observed through 2025-12-31. Deployed ~$45k into strongest trends: GOOGL (200->313, holds above breakout), AAPL (steady uptrend into 271, near highs), APP (520 Nov low -> 733 Dec, pullback to 673 = momentum), WMT (101->111 defensive uptrend), AMZN and BKNG (large-cap recovery basing). Avoided weak/downer: NFLX, CRWD, META, MSFT, NVDA, PLTR, AVGO, TSLA (sharp 3-day drop 488->449). Keep ~$5k cash buffer. Reconsider if trends break 50-day or on sharp reversal.

Holdings bought Jan2 open sold off into Jan2 close; APP crashed 673.82->618.32 (-8.2%) on 5.6M vol vs ~2M, breaking momentum (-15% from 733 peak). Broad Jan2 rotation: software dumped (PLTR -5.5%, INTU -5%, CRWD -3.2%) while semis surged (MU +10.5% to 315.42 on 42M vol, LRCX +8% to 185 on 12M vol, AMAT +4.6%, AMD +4.3%). Cut APP loss in full, rotate proceeds + part cash into strongest trends MU and LRCX. Keep GOOGL/AAPL/WMT/AMZN/BKNG (flat to -2%, intact). Reconsider if MU/LRCX reverse or APP stabilizes.

Jan5: semis split - AMAT +5.7% (276.12 open=low to 284.32 close, 10.4M vol) and LRCX +5.2% (190.12 open=low to 194.76) held strong; MU -1% (325.13 open/high to 312.15 close, 34.6M) and AMD -1% (230 open to 221 close) showed intraday exhaustion reversals. AAPL weakest holding: 271.01->267.26 (-1.4%) on expanding 45.6M vol, breaking below 270 support, underperforming. AMZN bounced +2.9% to 233.06, GOOGL/WMT/BKNG flat-to-up. Sell full AAPL (~36.73u) to cut breakdown, rotate ~$9k into strongest semi-equipment AMAT. Hold MU (trend still +9% from Dec31, one red day not a break) and LRCX. Keep cash buffer. Reconsider if MU breaks below 300/Jan2 close or AMAT reverses.

Jan6: held semis surged - MU 318.28 open to 343.43 close (+10% vs 312.15) on 48.7M vol, high 344.55=close near high; LRCX 197.79 to 206.96 (+6.3%) 18.8M; AMAT 285.43 open=low to 296.01 (+4.1%) near high. Validates Jan6 rotation from AAPL to AMAT. AMZN breakout 232.1 to 240.93 (+3.4%) on 53.8M vol to new high; WMT 112.4 to 114.34 (+1.5%) near high 114.79. GOOGL -0.7% to 314.34 with intraday 320.94-311.78 rejection but still above Dec31; BKNG flat 5348. External checks: AMD -3% to 214.35 on 40M, TSLA -4.1% to 432.96 on 89M, APP -2.5% to 617.24, NVDA/AVGO/META flat - no better momentum than holdings. Hold all, keep $1.6k cash. Reconsider if MU closes below ~318 low, LRCX below 197, AMAT below 285, or AMZN fails back below 233.

Jan7: digestion day, hold all. GOOGL breakout 314.36 to 321.98 (+2.4%) on 35.1M vol to new high (high 326.15); BKNG 5321 low to 5445.72 (+1.8%) breakout. AMZN 239.61 to 241.56 (+0.3%) consolidating near high 245.29 on lower 42.2M vol. Semis consolidated on declining vol: MU 340.71 to 339.55 (-1.1%) 32.8M vs 48.7M, held well above 318; LRCX 202.58 to 203.08 (-1.9%) 15.1M vs 18.8M, low 199.8 held above 197; AMAT 292 to 292.2 (-1.3%) 6.1M vs 7.2M, low 290 held above 285. WMT -1.4% to 112.72 on 23.3M, back to flat vs Dec31 but above support. Externals show no better momentum: NVDA flat 189.11, AMD -2% to 210.02 continuing down, TSLA flat 431.41, META -1.8% to 648.69, AVGO flat 343.5, APP +2.5% to 632.92 still broken. Keep $1.6k cash. Reconsider if MU closes below 318, LRCX below 197, AMAT below 285, GOOGL fails back below 314, or BKNG below 5320.

Jan8: cut AMAT on support break, hold rest. AMAT 290.7 open to 281.64 close (-3.6%) with 279.45 low breaking below 285 support and below 284.32 Jan5 close on 5.5M vol; now below avg 285.43 for loss vs +9.6% still from Dec31 but weakest semi. MU 342.9 to 327.02 (-3.7%) low 321.36 held above 318, still +14.6% from Dec31; LRCX 202.87 to 200.96 (-1.0%) low 195.04 intraday dip but closed above 197/200, best semi +17.4%. Sector-wide semi sell: NVDA -2.2% to 185.04, AMD -2.5% to 204.68, AVGO -3.2% to 332.48. Winners held: AMZN 243.06 to 246.29 (+2%) new high; GOOGL 328.97 to 325.44 (+1.1%) breakout hold; BKNG flat 5445 consolidating; WMT 111.29 low 109.81 to 113.07 close (+0.3%) hammer recovery. No better external momentum (TSLA bounce +1% still downtrend, AAPL -0.5% to 259.04 continued breakdown). Sell full AMAT 31.53u to enforce 285 rule, raise cash, hold 6 others. Reconsider if MU closes below 318, LRCX below 197 close, GOOGL below 314, AMZN below 233, or AMAT reclaims 285-292 with strength.

Jan9: all 6 held at new highs on strength. LRCX 204.66 to 218.36 (+8.7%) high 219.59 on 16.8M vol expansion vs 13.9M, best +27.6% vs Dec31; MU 332.75 to 345.09 (+5.5%) close near high 345.8 on 33.4M, +20.9% vs Dec31; AMZN 244.57 to 247.38 (+0.4%) new high on declining 34.6M digestion; GOOGL 327.09 to 328.57 (+1%) new high; BKNG 5415 to 5492.11 (+0.9%) new high high 5518 on 204k expansion; WMT 112.26=open=low to 114.53 (+1.3%) bullish. No better externals: NVDA 184.86 continued down, AMD 203.17 breakdown, AAPL 259.37 flat breakdown, META 653 still below 660, MSFT 479 below 483, TSLA 445 bounce still below Dec31, AVGO 344.97 bounce still below 346, APP 647 bounce still broken. Pyramid winners with AMAT cash: add ~$5k AMZN (orderly large-cap leader +7.1%) and ~$5k LRCX (semi leader with volume). Hold other 4. Reconsider if LRCX closes below 200/197, MU below 318-321, AMZN below 233, GOOGL below 314, BKNG below 5320, WMT below 109.8.

Jan12: hold all 6, no cash to add. WMT gap-up 114.53 to 117.97 (+3%) high 118.84 on 49.2M vs 21.9M institutional surge; GOOGL 325.8 to 331.86 (+1%) new high high 334.04 on 33.9M expansion; LRCX 216.12 to 220.40 (+0.9%) new high; MU 340.55 to 345.87 (+0.2%) new high high 348.47 digestion on lower 23.2M; AMZN 246.73 to 246.47 (-0.4%) digestion near high 248.94; BKNG 5454=open=high to 5391.52 (-1.8%) pullback on lower 179k, held above 5320 and avg. No better externals: NVDA 184.94 flat below Dec31, AMD 207.69 bounce still below 214, AAPL 260.25 flat breakdown, META 641.97 -1.7% breakdown, MSFT 477 down, TSLA 448.96 still below Dec31, AVGO 352.2 reclaim +2% but only +1.7% vs Dec31 lagging MU/LRCX, APP 658 still broken. Keep $0.68k cash. Reconsider if WMT closes below 109.8/112, GOOGL below 314, LRCX below 200/197, MU below 318-321, AMZN below 233, BKNG below 5320.

Jan13: hold all 6, no cash to add. WMT 117.97 to 120.36 (+2%) new high high 120.51 on 31.2M continued surge; GOOGL 331.86 to 335.97 (+1.2%) new high high 340.49 on 33.5M; LRCX 220.40 to 214.38 (-2.7%) pullback high 220.57 low 213.39 on 12.7M still well above 200/197; MU 345.87 to 338.13 (-2.2%) reversal high 351.23 new intraday then low 335.22 close on 23.9M still above 318-321; AMZN 246.47 to 242.60 (-1.6%) distribution low 240.25 on 38.3M up vs 35.9M still above 233 and avg 238.79; BKNG 5391.52 to 5314.71 (-1.4%) second down low 5268 close marginally below 5320 and avg 5356 on 189k not expanding vs 204k up-day. Externals: AMD 207.69 to 220.97 (+6.4%) gap-up high 223.11 on 56.9M breakout above Dec31 214.16 but one-day chase after 5-day downtrend; AMAT 307.24 to 304.87 (-0.8%) digestion after whipsaw reclaim from our 281.64 sale to 301-307; AVGO 352.2 to 354.61 (+0.7%) grind high 359.49; NVDA 184.94 to 185.81 flat, META/MSFT/TSLA still weak. Not chasing AMD spike for marginal BKNG break (0.1% below 5320); give BKNG one-day confirmation. Reconsider if BKNG closes below 5268/5280, AMZN below 240/233, MU below 335/318, LRCX below 213/200, GOOGL below 314, WMT below 117.7.

Jan14: sell BKNG breakdown, rotate to AMD breakout. BKNG 5314.71 to 5187.02 (-2.4%) low 5057.49 intraday crash high 5280.30 on 248k expansion vs 189k, close well below 5320/5280/5268 and avg 5356, confirms distribution after 3 downs. AMZN 242.60 to 236.65 (-2.45%) low 236.22 on 41.4M expanding vs 38.3M, closed below avg 238.79 and 240 but still above 233 - hold one-day watch. LRCX 214.38 to 208.79 (-2.6%) low 206.61 on 18.1M expansion but still above 200/197 - hold. MU 338.13 to 333.35 (-1.4%) low 328.20 on declining 20.2M still above 318-321 - hold. GOOGL 335.97 to 335.84 flat high 336.52 low 330.48 on lower 28.5M digestion - hold. WMT 120.36 to 120.04 flat high 121.24 on 32.7M - hold. AMD 220.97 to 223.60 (+1.2%) high 224.09 low 215.11 on 40.4M, 2-day hold above Dec31 214.16 confirms breakout vs one-day chase; AVGO crashed to 339.89 (-4.1%) on 30M, APP crashed to 617.76 (-7.6%) on 8.4M, META/NVDA weak. Fund AMD with BKNG sale, keep ~$0.7k buffer. Reconsider if AMD closes below 214/215, AMZN below 233, LRCX below 200, MU below 318, GOOGL below 314, WMT below 117.7.

Jan15: hold all 6, no cash to add. Gap-up fade day but closes above triggers. LRCX 208.79 to 217.47 (+4.2%) open 228.15 high 229.57 low 217.21 fade to near low on 15.2M; MU 333.35 to 336.63 (+1%) open 345.33 high 347.77 low 336.27 fade to low on 25.4M expansion; AMD 223.60 to 227.92 (+1.9%) open 227.90 high 238.35 low 227.22 flat close on 55.3M expansion - 3rd day above Dec31 214.16 but intraday exhaustion watch. AMZN 236.65 to 238.18 (+0.6%) high 240.65 low 236.63 on 43.0M expansion, still below avg 238.79. GOOGL 335.84 to 332.78 (-0.9%) open 337.65 high 337.69 low 330.74 reversal on 28.4M. WMT 120.04 to 119.20 (-0.7%) high 120.87 low 118.73 on 34.6M expansion, 2nd down but above 117.7. No confirmed breakdown, keep $0.7k buffer. Reconsider if AMD closes below 214/215, LRCX below 200, MU below 318, AMZN below 233, GOOGL below 314, WMT below 117.7.

Jan16: hold all 6, no cash to add. MU 336.63 to 362.75 (+7.8%) gap-up open 353.10 high 365.81 low 352.04 close near high on 47.9M expansion - major breakout; LRCX 217.47 to 222.96 (+2.5%) high 225.69 low 219.0 close on 14.4M - uptrend hold; AMD 227.92 to 231.83 (+1.7%) high 234.49 low 228.86 on 42.5M - 4th day above Dec31 214.16 breakout hold; AMZN 238.18 to 239.12 (+0.4%) high 239.57 low 236.41 on 45.9M, reclaim above avg 238.79; WMT 119.20 to 119.70 (+0.4%) high 120.60 low 116.90 close on 415M volume spike, holds above 117.7; GOOGL 332.78 to 330.0 (-0.8%) high 334.65 low 327.70 on 40.3M expansion, 3rd down but well above 314. No breakdowns. Reconsider if AMD closes below 214/215, LRCX below 200, MU below 318, AMZN below 233, GOOGL below 314, WMT below 117.7.

Jan20: sell AMZN breakdown, rotate to COST strength. AMZN 239.12 to 231.0 (-3.4%) open 233.76 high 235.09 low 229.34 close below 233 trigger and avg 238.79 on 47.7M expansion; breakdown vs 236 lows. COST 963.61 to 964.26 (+0.1%) high 969.9 low 954.13 on 3.2M, 7th up in 8 days, defensive new high while NVDA -4.4% to 178.07, AVGO -5.4% to 332.6, TSLA -4.2% to 419.25, AAPL -3.5% to 246.7, META -2.6%, MSFT weak. Hold MU 362.75 to 365.0 (+0.6%) high 381.56 low 361.35 on 49.7M - uptrend; LRCX 222.96 to 222.41 (-0.2%) - digestion above 200; AMD 231.83 to 231.92 flat high 239.5 - 5th day above 214.16; GOOGL 330 to 322 (-2.4%) 4th down but above 314; WMT 119.70 to 118.71 (-0.8%) low 117.61 intraday nick but close above 117.7. Sell all AMZN to fund ~9 sh COST (~$9k) keep buffer. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, AMD below 214/215, LRCX below 200, MU below 318, GOOGL below 314, WMT close below 117.7.

Jan21: hold all 6, broad strength. MU 365 to 389.11 (+6.6%) high 394.2 low 366.73 close near high on 56.7M expansion - breakout continuation; AMD 231.92 to 249.8 (+7.7%) high 252.9 low 235.78 on 62.4M expansion - major breakout, 6th day above 214.16; LRCX 222.41 to 228.39 (+2.7%) high 232.9 - new high; COST 964.26 to 982.86 (+1.9%) high 989.64 on 4.07M - defensive breakout; GOOGL 322 to 328.38 (+2%) high 332.48 - bounce; WMT 118.71 to 119.36 (+0.5%) holds above 117.7. No breakdowns, keep $1.4k buffer. Reconsider if AMD closes below 214/215, LRCX below 200, MU below 318, COST below 930, GOOGL below 314, WMT below 117.7.

Jan22: hold all 6. MU 389.11 to 397.58 (+2.2%) high 397.78 low 376.92 open 396.64 close near high on 39.6M - volatile dip recovered, breakout continuation; AMD 249.8 to 253.73 (+1.6%) high 256.08 low 246.63 on 37.9M - continuation, 7th day above 214.16; COST 982.86 to 976.17 (-0.7%) high 984 low 971.56 on 2.07M light - digestion near high; GOOGL 328.38 to 330.54 (+0.7%) high 335.15 low 328.75 on 26.3M lighter - digestion below 335-336; WMT 119.36 to 117.83 (-1.3%) high 119.52 low 117.65 close just above 117.7 support on 24.5M - test, holds; LRCX 228.39 to 220.70 (-3.4%) open 235.56 high 236.10 low 219.76 on 12.0M - key reversal, gap to new high then close near low, caution but still well above 200 trend. No trigger breaks, keep $1.4k buffer. Reconsider if WMT closes below 117.7, LRCX closes below 200 (or follow-through below 219), AMD below 214/215, MU below 318, COST below 930, GOOGL below 314.

Jan23: hold all 6. MU 397.58 to 399.65 (+0.5%) high 412.43 low 390.74 on 35.4M lighter - intraday spike faded but close up, breakout holds; AMD 253.73 to 259.68 (+2.3%) high 266.96 low 256.25 on 47.5M expansion - continuation, 8th day above 214.16; COST 976.17 to 983.25 (+0.7%) high 984.85 low 971.01 on 1.68M light - new-high close, defensive; GOOGL 330.54 to 327.93 (-0.8%) high 333.69 low 327.45 on 27.3M - digestion, still above 314, below 335-336; WMT 117.83 to 117.73 (-0.1%) high 118.61 low 117.14 on 20.8M lighter - intraday nick below 117.7 but close holds; LRCX 220.70 to 217.94 (-1.3%) high 223.36 low 213.87 on 10.2M lighter - follow-through after reversal, still above 200 trend. No close breaks, keep $1.4k buffer. Reconsider if WMT closes below 117.7, LRCX below 200, AMD below 214/215, MU below 318, COST below 930, GOOGL below 314.

Jan26: hold all 6. GOOGL 327.93 to 333.26 (+1.6%) high 335.84 low 327.0 on 26.0M - bounce back toward 335-336 resistance, strength; WMT 117.73 to 117.64 (-0.1%) high 118.85 low 117.39 on 19.6M lighter - 3rd day tight at 117.6-117.7 support, marginal nick below 117.7 but flat and selling lighter, no breakdown; MU 399.65 to 389.09 (-2.6%) high 398 low 384.30 on 29.2M lighter - first pullback after breakout run, holds well above 318; LRCX 217.94 to 222.87 (+2.3%) high 225.35 low 215.93 on 10.6M - bounce reclaiming after key reversal, still above 200 trend; AMD 259.68 to 251.31 (-3.2%) high 258.29 low 250.30 on 30.7M lighter - digestion after 8-day run, still well above 214/215; COST 983.25 to 977.67 (-0.6%) high 993 low 976.35 on 2.46M - intraday new high to 993 faded to close down, watch but still near highs. No trigger breaks, keep $1.4k buffer. Reconsider if WMT closes below 117 with expansion, LRCX below 200, AMD below 214/215, MU below 318, COST below 930, GOOGL below 314.

Jan27: hold all 6. GOOGL 333.26 to 334.55 (+0.4%) high 337.91 low 333.48 on 21.6M lighter - intraday push above 335-336 to 337.91 faded but close up, holds above 314; WMT 117.64 to 116.94 (-0.6%) high 117.63 low 115.48 on 23.0M expansion - marginal close below 117 support with intraday wash to 115.48 recovered, weak but off low, watch for follow-through; MU 389.09 to 410.24 (+5.4%) high 416.45 low 399.60 on 36.2M expansion - breakout resumption to new high, strength; LRCX 222.87 to 238.46 (+7.0%) high 239.5 low 228.76 on 12.0M expansion - gap and new-high close above 236.10 reversal high, strength; AMD 251.31 to 252.03 (+0.3%) high 255.55 low 247.96 on 25.7M lighter - flat digestion, holds well above 214/215; COST 977.67 to 970.28 (-0.8%) high 978 low 961.71 on 2.08M lighter - second fade from 993 high, dip to 961.71 recovered, still above 930. No full exit yet, keep $1.4k buffer. Reconsider if WMT fails to reclaim 117.6 or closes below 115.5, LRCX below 220, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, COST below 930, GOOGL below 327.

Jan28: sell all WMT, hold other 5. GOOGL 334.55 to 336.01 (+0.4%) high 337.54 low 331.94 on 27.4M expansion - holds above 335-336, strength; WMT 116.94 to 116.57 (-0.3%) high 117.46 low 115.87 on 16.3M lighter - 2nd close below 117, failed to reclaim 117.6 (high 117.46), weak vs portfolio, exit to lock +4.6% vs 111.43 cost; MU 410.24 to 435.28 (+6.1%) high 438.94 low 417 on 42.7M expansion - new-high continuation, strength; LRCX 238.46 to 239.58 (+0.5%) high 243.99 low 237.14 on 15.6M expansion - new-high intraday, holds above 220, strength; AMD 252.03 to 252.74 (+0.3%) high 257.4 low 250.21 on 27.1M - flat digestion, holds above 214/215; COST 970.28 to 960.78 (-1.0%) high 970.1 low 955.61 on 2.47M expansion - 3rd fade from 993, still above 930, hold but watch. Hold cash proceeds, no chase into extended MU/LRCX. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, GOOGL below 327, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, LRCX below 220.

Jan29: hold all 5. GOOGL 336.01 to 338.25 (+0.7%) high 342.29 low 326.54 on 39.8M expansion - volatile wash to 326.5 recovered to close near highs, holds above 327-335 on close, strength but watch intraday break; MU 435.28 to 435.79 (+0.1%) high 444.71 low 417.70 on 42.7M even - new-high intraday to 444.7 faded to flat, digestion, holds well above 384; LRCX 239.58 to 248.17 (+3.6%) high 251.38 low 236.82 on 16.8M expansion - new-high continuation, strength; AMD 252.74 to 252.18 (-0.2%) high 260.53 low 240.91 on 31.7M expansion - new-high intraday faded with market-wide wash, flat close, holds above 214/215; COST 960.78 to 952.89 (-0.8%) high 960.30 low 948.51 on 1.83M lighter - 4th fade from 993, selling lighter, still above 930. No breakdowns on close, keep cash buffer, no chase into extended MU/LRCX. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, GOOGL closes below 327, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, LRCX below 220.

Jan30: hold all 5. GOOGL 338.25 to 338.00 (-0.1%) high 340.00 low 332.29 on 31.0M lighter - flat digestion, holds above 327; MU 435.79 to 414.88 (-4.8%) high 455.50 low 407.13 on 51.0M expansion - sharp reversal from new-high 455.5 to close near lows, still above 384 but distribution, watch; LRCX 248.17 to 233.46 (-5.9%) high 251.87 low 232.00 on 18.4M expansion - sharp reversal to near low, still above 220 but weak; AMD 252.18 to 236.73 (-6.1%) high 245.24 low 234.55 on 40.0M expansion - gap-down continuation, still above 214/215 but heavy selling; COST 952.89 to 940.25 (-1.3%) high 951.12 low 930.30 on 2.40M expansion - 5th fade, tested 930.30 intraday and held on close, still above 930. Broad semi wash on expanding volume, no close below supports yet. Keep large cash buffer incl Feb deposit, no buys into distribution. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, GOOGL below 327, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, LRCX below 220.

Feb02: hold all 5. GOOGL 338.00 to 343.69 (+1.7%) high 344.83 low 335.63 on 32.0M - new-high close, strength; MU 414.88 to 437.80 (+5.5%) high 442.43 low 410.00 on 37.8M lighter - engulfing bounce held 410 above 407/384, recovery but still volatile; LRCX 233.46 to 237.50 (+1.7%) high 242.95 low 232.00 on 13.3M lighter - held 232 low, light-volume bounce, still below 248; AMD 236.73 to 246.27 (+4.0%) high 249.97 low 235.00 on 36.3M lighter - strong bounce held 235 above 214/215; COST 940.25 to 968.36 (+3.0%) high 970.32 low 931.27 on 2.45M even - engulfing reclaim, held 931 above 930, closed near high, strength. Broad recovery negates Jan30 wash, no close below supports. Keep cash buffer, no chase after one-day bounce. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, GOOGL below 327, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, LRCX below 220.

Feb03: hold all 5. GOOGL 343.69 to 339.71 (-1.2%) high 349.00 low 337.47 on 36.5M expansion - gap to new high faded to bearish reversal, still above 327; MU 437.80 to 419.44 (-4.2%) high 442.30 low 407.53 on 42.8M expansion - second spike-and-reverse from 442, tested 407.5 near Jan30 low, still above 384 but heavy supply; LRCX 237.50 to 230.10 (-3.1%) high 246.62 low 226.88 on 13.5M - gap to 246.6 reversed to break prior 232 low, closed weak but still above 220; AMD 246.27 to 242.11 (-1.7%) high 252.65 low 237.04 on 53.1M expansion - gap to 252.6 faded, held 237 above 235/214; COST 968.36 to 977.92 (+1.0%) high 990.65 low 964.28 on 2.96M expansion - strength to near 993, holds above 930. Semi reversal on expanding volume offsets Feb02 bounce, but no close below supports. Keep cash buffer, no buys into distribution. Reconsider if COST closes below 930, GOOGL below 327, AMD below 214/215, MU below 384, LRCX below 220.

Feb04: semi breakdown on expanding volume, exit 3 broken names. GOOGL 339.71 to 333.04 (-2.0%) high 343.31 low 328.52 on 70.6M 2x expansion - sharp fade, low 328.5 held above 327, holds; MU 419.44 to 379.40 (-9.6%) high 413.00 low 363.90 on 58.1M expansion - crash through 384 to 363.9, close 379.4 still below 384, breakdown; LRCX 230.10 to 209.78 (-8.8%) high 231.11 low 205.11 on 19.6M expansion - broke 220 decisively, closed weak near 205 low; AMD 242.11 to 200.19 (-17.3%) high 218.58 low 199.15 on 107.2M huge expansion - gap-down from 242 to 215 open, broke 214/215 and 235, close near low; COST 977.92 to 978.35 (+0.0%) high 994.60 low 975.19 on 2.63M lighter - new intraday high, holds above 930, strength. Three supports broken, discipline requires exit. Sell all AMD/MU/LRCX, hold GOOGL (above 327) and COST (strength) + large cash. Reconsider if GOOGL closes below 327 or COST below 930; re-enter semis only on reclaim of 384/220/214 with volume.

Feb05: extreme intraday volatility, hold both. GOOGL 333.04 to 331.25 (-0.5%) high 332.69 low 306.46 on 88.2M huge expansion - gapped to 312.22, flushed to 306.46 well below 327, but recovered to close 331.25 above 327 near high, hammer reversal; COST 978.35 to 989.29 (+1.1%) high 1000.95 low 987.33 on 2.99M - new 1000 intraday high, closed positive, holds above 930, strength. No close below supports, so hold GOOGL/COST + large cash. No buys into 8% intraday swings. Reconsider if GOOGL closes below 327 (306.46 breakdown confirms) or COST below 930.

Feb06: GOOGL broke support, COST new high. GOOGL 331.25 to 322.86 (-2.5%) high 330.38 low 319.92 on 56.38M elevated - closed below 327 support, low 319.9 confirms Feb05 306.46 flush was not one-off; distribution. COST 989.29 to 1001.16 (+1.2%) high 1001.37 low 983.5 on 2.36M - closed at new high above 1000, holds well above 930, strength. Discipline requires exit broken name. Sell all GOOGL, hold COST + large cash. No buys into semi volatility. Reconsider if COST closes below 930; re-enter GOOGL only on reclaim of 327 with volume.

Feb09: hold COST + cash, no reclaim in exits. COST 1001.16 to 997.59 (-0.4%) high 1009.62 low 992.68 on 1.86M lighter - new intraday high, closed just below 1000 well above 930, strength intact. GOOGL 322.86 to 324.32 (+1.1%) high 327.70 low 317.26 - touched 327 intraday but closed below, no reclaim. MU 394.69 to 383.50 (-2.8%) closed below 384, fail. AMD 208.44 to 216.00 (+3.6%) above 214 but on 38.8M lighter vs 107M breakdown, unconvincing. LRCX 231.01 to 229.28 holds above 220 but on 10M light volume. No volume-confirmed reclaim, stay defensive. Reconsider if COST closes below 930 (exit); re-enter only on close above 327/384/220/214 with expansion.

Feb10: hold COST + cash, no buys. COST 997.59 to 971.23 (-2.6%) high 997.45 low 969.0 on 1.78M flat - sharpest pullback since new high, closed near low but well above 930 support, no exit signal.
